meta.model_label: LightGBM, swap-safe features + ATL weather, with a daily correction fitted on the previous 7 days
month_results: Whole test month: model ROC-AUC 0.772 (95% interval 0.744 to 0.798).
With 3 spares and H = 4 h, greedy reached 91.6% of the optimization's expected minutes (95% interval 90.4 to 92.8%).
Flights given a spare were really delayed 46.2% of the time (optimization) vs 21.9% for random picks.
